name: KEYASIC
recent: Key ASIC 与 CT Vision 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚共同开发 300MW 绿色 AI 数据中心。公司同时正在推进私募配售，并已获交易所批准延长 6 个月完成期限。最新季度营收同比和环比均下滑，但公司实现盈利。
notable: 与 CT Vision 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚开发 300MW 绿色 AI 数据中心。
交易所批准将私募配售完成期限延长 6 个月，至 2027 年 4 月 14 日。
第 20 届常年股东大会所有决议均以投票方式通过。
risks: 公司正在进行私募配售，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
最新季度营收同比下滑 36.5%，环比下滑 32.1%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度营收为 MYR 3,834,000，同比下滑 36.5%，环比下滑 32.1%；净利润为 MYR 499,000，净利率 13.0%，上一季度净利率为 -27.0%。

recent_en: Key ASIC signed an MOU with CT Vision to jointly develop a 300MW green AI data centre in Malaysia. The company is also progressing its private placement, having obtained a 6-month extension from the exchange to complete it. Latest quarterly revenue declined both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter, but the company turned profitable.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with CT Vision to develop a 300MW green AI data centre in Malaysia.
The exchange approved a 6-month extension for completing the private placement, to 14 April 2027.
All resolutions at the 20th AGM were passed by poll.
risks_en: The company is undertaking a private placement, which may dilute existing shareholders.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 36.5% year-on-year and 32.1% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was MYR 3,834,000, down 36.5% year-on-year and 32.1% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR 499,000 with a net margin of 13.0%, compared with a net margin of -27.0% in the previous quarter.
